headline: America's first car race, in the snow

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in eighteen ninety-five... America held its first car race, in the snow.

scenes.label: A Duryea motor wagon
scenes.caption: Scientific American, 1890s
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] Only six cars reached the start in Chicago, for a fifty-four-mile round trip.

scenes.label: cars made it to the finish
A Duryea car today
scenes.caption: Peoria Riverfront Museum, Illinois
scenes.text: [softly] Frank Duryea won, after about ten hours on snowy roads... and took home two thousand dollars.

scenes.title: Would you have raced?
scenes.text: [gently] Would you have raced in that weather?
